about: Test cases for the bug reports Dirnex sends to POST /api/bug-reports. Kept in dirnex-home/web/src/bug-reports/ and copied unchanged into the app as DirnexCore/Tests/DirnexCoreTests/Fixtures/bug-report-vectors.json. Limits count UTF-8 bytes. tooLarge has no case here, since one would be half a megabyte: both sides test it from limits.bodyBytes. Each case has body (a JSON value, sent as JSON), raw (a text, sent as it is) or rawBase64 (bytes). report is what the server keeps.
